caption:
Rehearse before the real conversation. 🎤

Try: "Act as a tough client. I'll pitch my price, you push back. Stay in character, then give me feedback."

Great for interviews, pitches and hard emails.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #aitools #promptengineering #aitips #interviewtips #productivity #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: Dreading a tough talk? Rehearse it first.
scenes.say: Dreading a tough talk? Rehearse it first. AI is a patient practice partner.

scenes.title: Give it a role
scenes.user: Act as a tough client. I'll pitch my price, you push back.
scenes.reply:
Got it. I'm the client.
Go ahead and pitch.
I'll question every number.
scenes.say: Try this. Tell the AI to act as a tough client, and push back on your price.

scenes.title: Practice a hard talk
items: Name the role and the scene
Answer as you would for real
Ask for feedback at the end
scenes.say: Three steps. Name the role and the scene. Answer as you would for real. Then ask for feedback at the end.

scenes.title: Ask it to stay in character
scenes.body: Then say: now step out and give me feedback.
scenes.say: Bonus. Ask it to stay in character, then step out and give you feedback.
Without practice, you freeze when they push back. With practice, you have heard it before.

scenes.say: Save this before your next big conversation. Follow TechMendly for a new tech tip every day.
